title: Chairman and Speaker Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 1985

sections.shortTitle: Chairman and Speaker Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 1985
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT II OF 1985
ACT II OF 1985
CHAIRMAN AND SPEAKER (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES
AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1985
An Act further to amend the Chairman and Speaker (Salaries Allowances
and Privileges) Act, 1975
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part II, 1st July, 1985]
1. Short title and commencement.----(1) This Act may be called the Chairman and Speaker (Salaries, Allowances
and Privileges) (Amend ment) Act, 1985.
(2) It shall come into force at once and shall be deemed to have taken
effect on the first day of March, 1985.

sections.shortTitle: Chairman and Speaker Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 1985

Amendment of section 3, Act LXXXII of 1975

ACT II OF 1985
ACT II OF 1985

AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1985
An Act further to amend the Chairman and Speaker (Salaries Allowances
and Privileges) Act, 1975
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part II, 1st July, 1985]
2. Amendment of section 3, Act LXXXII of 1975.-----In the Chairman and Speaker (Salaries,
Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975 (LXXXII of 1975), hereinafter referred to
as the said Act, in section 3, for the words "four thousand rupees"
the words "seven thousand rupees" shall be substituted.

sections.shortTitle: Chairman and Speaker Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 1985
sections.description:
Amendment of section 8, Act LXXXII of 1975

ACT II OF 1985
ACT II OF 1985
CHAIRMAN AND SPEAKER (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES
AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1985
An Act further to amend the Chairman and Speaker (Salaries Allowances
and Privileges) Act, 1975
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part II, 1st July, 1985]
5. Amendment of section 8, Act LXXXII of 1975.----In the said Act, in section 8,-
(a) in sub-section (1), for the proviso the following shall be
substituted, namely .-
"Provided that half of the electricity and gas charges in excess of
one thousand rupees per mensem shall be paid by the Chairman or, as the case
may be, the Speaker." ;
(b) after subsection (1), amended as aforesaid, the following new sub section
shall be inserted, namely :-
"(1A) The assessed rent of house hired for the use of the Chairman
or the Speaker shall in no case exceed eight thousand rupees per mensem.";
(c) in subsection (2), for the words "thirty thousand rupees"
the words "sixty thousand rupees" shall be substituted ;
(d) in subsection (3), for the words "one thousand two hundred and
fifty rupees the words "eight thousand rupees" shall be substituted
and
(e) in subsection (4), for the words "one thousand two hundred and
fifty rupees "the words "eight thousand rupees" shall be
substituted.

6. Amendment of section 9, Act LXXXII of 1975.---In the said Act, in section 9,-
(a) in subsection (2), in clause (b), for the words "fifty
rupees" the words "one hundred and fifty rupees" and for the
words "twenty-five rupees" the words "seventy-five rupees"
shall be substituted ;
(b) in sub-section (3), in clause (b) for the words "fifty
rupees" the words "one hundred and fifty rupees" and for the
words "twenty-five rupees" the words "seventy-five rupees"
shall be substituted ; and
(c) in subsection (5), for the words "one rupee per mile" the
words "two rupees per kilometre" and for the words "seventy-five
paisa per mile" the words ` one rupee and fifty paisa per kilometre",
and for the words "fifty rupees" the words "one hundred and
fifty rupees" shall be substituted.
